class.name: OcgGraphic3dShaderprogram
class.brief_description: This class is responsible for managing shader programs.
class.description: ! This class is responsible for managing shader programs.

method.name: Graphic3d_ShaderProgram
method.description: Creates new empty program object.

method.name: IsDone
method.description: Checks if the program object is valid or not.

method.name: NbLightsMax
method.description: Return the length of array of light sources (THE_MAX_LIGHTS), to be used for initialization occLightSources. Default value is THE_MAX_LIGHTS_DEFAULT.

method.name: SetNbLightsMax
method.description: Specify the length of array of light sources (THE_MAX_LIGHTS).

method.name: NbShadowMaps
method.description: Return the length of array of shadow maps (THE_NB_SHADOWMAPS); 0 by default.

method.name: SetNbShadowMaps
method.description: Specify the length of array of shadow maps (THE_NB_SHADOWMAPS).

method.name: NbClipPlanesMax
method.description: Return the length of array of clipping planes (THE_MAX_CLIP_PLANES), to be used for initialization occClipPlaneEquations. Default value is THE_MAX_CLIP_PLANES_DEFAULT.

method.name: SetNbClipPlanesMax
method.description: Specify the length of array of clipping planes (THE_MAX_CLIP_PLANES).

method.name: AttachShader
method.description: Attaches shader object to the program object.

method.name: DetachShader
method.description: Detaches shader object from the program object.

method.name: NbFragmentOutputs
method.description: Returns the number (1+) of Fragment Shader outputs to be written to (more than 1 can be in case of multiple draw buffers); 1 by default.

method.name: SetNbFragmentOutputs
method.description: Sets the number of Fragment Shader outputs to be written to. Should be done before GLSL program initialization.

method.name: HasAlphaTest
method.description: Return true if Fragment Shader should perform alpha test; FALSE by default.

method.name: SetAlphaTest
method.description: Set if Fragment Shader should perform alpha test. Note that this flag is designed for usage with - custom shader program may discard fragment regardless this flag.

method.name: HasDefaultSampler
method.description: Return TRUE if standard program header should define default texture sampler occSampler0; TRUE by default for compatibility.

method.name: SetDefaultSampler
method.description: Set if standard program header should define default texture sampler occSampler0.

method.name: OitOutput
method.description: Return if Fragment Shader color should output to OIT buffers; OFF by default.

method.name: SetOitOutput
method.description: Set if Fragment Shader color should output to OIT buffers. Note that weighted OIT also requires at least 2 Fragment Outputs (color + coverage), and Depth Peeling requires at least 3 Fragment Outputs (depth + front color + back color),

method.name: IsPBR
method.description: Return TRUE if standard program header should define functions and variables used in PBR pipeline. FALSE by default.

method.name: SetPBR
method.description: Sets whether standard program header should define functions and variables used in PBR pipeline.

method.name: TextureSetBits
method.description: Return texture units declared within the program,

method.name: SetTextureSetBits
method.description: Set texture units declared within the program.

method.name: ClearVariables
method.description: Removes all custom uniform variables from the program.
